formatting_only_changes: Markdown headings, emphasis, lists, code blocks, citations, tables, and display math converted to LaTeX syntax.
Short mathematical symbols were retained as displays; prose arrows were represented with standard LaTeX math arrows.
Wide pseudocode is a normal double-column float to avoid column overlap; its statements are unchanged.
F1--F4 descriptions became neutral occupancy placeholders with the complete frozen captions.
Table and figure mentions became LaTeX cross-references.
One bibliography howpublished field replaced Markdown backticks with LaTeX texttt syntax and escaped an underscore; bibliographic facts are unchanged.
